Run `codex` in a terminal to ask for code changes in plain language. Codex reads files, edits code, and runs commands. Sign in with your ChatGPT account or an API key.

## Compatibility

Requires jailbroken iOS 15 or later and a roothide or rootless bootstrap that provides a shell. Choose `iphoneos-arm64e` for roothide or `iphoneos-arm64` for rootless. Both packages contain an arm64 binary.

Install from the [OwnGoal Studio repository](https://apt.owngoal.dev/) or install the matching package from [Releases](https://github.com/owngoal-dev/codex/releases) with `dpkg -i`. Run `dpkg --print-architecture` if you are unsure which bootstrap layout you use.
